answer: New agents join through a rationed admission queue: each epoch only 20 slots open, and winners pay a 15 POA ticket that is burned. A farm of N fakes needs N/20 epochs and burns 15N POA, so 1,000 fakes cost 15,000 POA and 50 epochs, while an honest user pays 15 POA once. Validators audit 6% of newcomers; an island of wallets sharing a funding source, or a forged yarrow-tagged referral, is slashed 80% of stake, so attack cost grows linearly with N.
